newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi King Fahd holds talks with Djibouti's president.
- GCC-EU meet helps 20 joint ventures get started.
- Saudi experts warn of water shortages if the present unrestrained consumption in the kingdom was not checked.
- Saudi takes new measures to curb increasing traffic accidents.
- Saudi King Fahd agrees to purchase a French frigate to support the Saudi army.
- Defence minister Prince Sultan opens military projects.
- Saudi to send aid to victims of Bangladesh's cylone.
- A Gulf official says moves to unified tariffs between Gulf Arab states closer to goal.
